_evidentia_demo_notice: DEMO / DISPLAY FIXTURE — synthetic, illustrative data backing the demo-only `#/demo/fda` showcase. The organization, device, findings, and the `_illustrative_signature` block below are invented for illustration and verify NOTHING. No signing key ships in this repository. Real deployments produce a signed Assessment Results document with `evidentia gap analyze --frameworks fda-524b-appendix1 ... && evidentia oscal sign` (GPG detached signature or Sigstore keyless). This file is not consumed by any verification path.

metadata.title: DEMO — Gap Analysis: Northwind MedTech (illustrative) · FDA Section 524B Appendix 1

parties.name: Northwind MedTech (illustrative)
parties.remarks: Synthetic device-maker invented for this demonstration. Not a real organization.

metadata.remarks: Synthetic illustration of a Section 524B premarket-cybersecurity gap analysis for connected medical-device software (SaMD). The eight security control categories are FDA's own Appendix 1 categories from the premarket cybersecurity guidance (a U.S.-Government work, paraphrased here in our own words). All organization, system, and finding content is invented for demonstration.

results.title: Evidentia Gap Analysis Result — FDA 524B Appendix 1
results.description: Automated gap analysis of Northwind MedTech (illustrative) device software against the FDA Section 524B Appendix 1 security control categories.

observations.title: Observation: 524B.A1 (Authentication)
observations.description: An unauthenticated maintenance/debug interface is exposed and the device-to-cloud channel does not perform mutual authentication, allowing an attacker to impersonate the device or the gateway.

observations.title: Observation: 524B.A3 (Cryptography)
observations.description: A symmetric key is hard-coded in firmware and shared across all units with no rotation, and a non-NIST-approved cipher is used on one link; a single extracted key would compromise the fleet.

observations.title: Observation: 524B.A4 (Code, Data, and Execution Integrity)
observations.description: Firmware images are not cryptographically signed and the device has no secure-boot chain, so modified or rolled-back firmware can run undetected.

observations.title: Observation: 524B.A8 (Updatability and Patchability)
observations.description: There is no validated mechanism to deliver authenticated out-of-cycle patches to fielded devices, which undercuts the postmarket vulnerability-management plan.

observations.title: Observation: 524B.A6 (Event Detection and Logging)
observations.description: Security-relevant events are recorded inconsistently and cannot be exported for monitoring, so incidents on fielded devices may go undetected and unprovable.

findings.title: 524B.A1: Authentication
findings.description: Control 524B.A1 (Authentication) is not implemented for the device's external interfaces.
findings.remarks: Establish a cryptographic device identity (per-device certificate via PKI), require mutual TLS on every external interface, and disable or authenticate the maintenance interface; map the authentication architecture to the threat model.

findings.title: 524B.A3: Cryptography
findings.description: Control 524B.A3 (Cryptography) is not implemented to an acceptable standard.
findings.remarks: Move to NIST-approved algorithms (AES-256, ECC), per-device keys generated and stored in hardware (TPM/HSM where available), and a defined rotation/revocation process; provide a cryptographic inventory and a path to crypto-agility for the post-quantum transition.

findings.title: 524B.A4: Code, Data, and Execution Integrity
findings.description: Control 524B.A4 (Code, Data, and Execution Integrity) is not implemented.
findings.remarks: Sign all firmware/software with a managed key, verify signatures in a secure-boot chain, and reject unsigned or downgraded images; capture the signing and verification evidence in the design history file.

findings.title: 524B.A8: Updatability and Patchability
findings.description: Control 524B.A8 (Updatability and Patchability) is only partially implemented.
findings.remarks: Implement authenticated, integrity-protected over-the-air updates with rollback protection on a reasonably justified cycle, plus an out-of-cycle path for critical vulnerabilities; tie the mechanism to the postmarket plan and coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

findings.title: 524B.A6: Event Detection and Logging
findings.description: Control 524B.A6 (Event Detection and Logging) is only partially implemented.
findings.remarks: Log security-relevant events to a tamper-evident store and provide an export path for the operator's monitoring; define which events are captured and how they support postmarket surveillance.

_illustrative_signature.notice: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY — this block is a display fixture, not a real signature. The hash is not computed from this file and verifies nothing; no signing key is committed to this repository. In production, `evidentia oscal sign` emits a GPG detached `.asc` sidecar, or Sigstore keyless signing records a Fulcio certificate + a Rekor transparency-log entry.
